items.source: BeanDefinitionDecorators should be aware that they may be part of a chain. In particular, a BeanDefinitionDecorator should be aware that a previous BeanDefinitionDecorator may have replaced the original BeanDefinition with a ProxyFactoryBean definition allowing for custom interceptors to be added.
items.translation: BeanDefinitionDecorators 应意识到它们可能处于链中。特别是，BeanDefinitionDecorator 应意识到之前的 BeanDefinitionDecorator 可能已将原始的 BeanDefinition 替换为 ProxyFactoryBean 定义，从而允许添加自定义的 interceptors。

items.source: Decoration may also occur based on custom attributes applied to the <bean> tag. Implementations are free to turn the metadata in the custom tag into as many BeanDefinitions as required and to transform the BeanDefinition of the enclosing <bean> tag, potentially even returning a completely different BeanDefinition to replace the original.
items.translation: 装饰也可能基于应用于<bean>标签的自定义属性而发生。实现可以自由选择将自定义标签中的元数据转换为所需的任意数量的BeanDefinitions，并转换包围的<bean>标签的BeanDefinition，甚至可能返回一个完全不同的BeanDefinition来替换原始定义。

items.source: BeanDefinitionDecorators that wish to add an interceptor to the enclosing bean should extend AbstractInterceptorDrivenBeanDefinitionDecorator which handles the chaining ensuring that only one proxy is created and that it contains all interceptors from the chain.
items.translation: BeanDefinitionDecorators 希望向包围的 Bean 添加拦截器的，应扩展 AbstractInterceptorDrivenBeanDefinitionDecorator，该接口负责处理链式调用，确保仅创建一个代理，且该代理包含链中的所有拦截器。

items.source: The parser locates a BeanDefinitionDecorator from the NamespaceHandler for the namespace in which the custom tag resides.
items.translation: 解析器从自定义标签所在的命名空间对应的 NamespaceHandler 中定位到 BeanDefinitionDecorator。

items.source: Implementations may choose to return a completely new definition, which will replace the original definition in the resulting BeanFactory.
items.translation: 实现可以选择返回一个全新的定义，该定义将替换结果中 BeanFactory 的原始定义。

items.source: The supplied ParserContext can be used to register any additional beans needed to support the main definition.
items.translation: 提供的 `ParserContext` 可用于注册支持主定义所需的任何附加 bean。

items.source: Parse the specified Node (either an element or an attribute) and decorate the supplied BeanDefinition, returning the decorated definition.
items.translation: 解析指定的Node（元素或属性），并装饰提供的BeanDefinition，返回装饰后的定义。
